must_keep.quote: Coach class or any discounted class shall be used in the interest of cost-efficiency. This policy applies to all travel (domestic or foreign, or any combination thereof) regardless of the purpose or fund source.
must_keep.why: coach is the rule for every trip, however long

must_keep.quote: Use of business or first-class may be authorized under the circumstances listed below.
must_keep.why: business only under a listed circumstance

must_keep.quote: Business or first-class is the only service offered between two points;

Transportation expenses shall be reimbursed based on the most economical mode of transportation and the most commonly traveled route consistent with the authorized purpose of the trip. Any exception must be approved by the Chancellor.
must_keep.why: the most economical fare; exceptions are the Chancellor's

design_notes: No coach seat is sold on the route at all (no economy offer is listed), so business is the only service offered between the two points (line 573); the cheaper of the two business offers. Background offers are off: a background economy offer would remove the circumstance.
